stem:
Charu rubs crushed mustard seeds on paper. A lasting oily patch shows when she holds the paper against the light. She also knows a starch test can give a blue-black colour.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The lasting oily patch shows that fat is present in the mustard seeds.
Starch is present in the mustard seeds because of the oily patch.
The oily patch is evidence of fat; a blue-black colour is not required for this paper test.
Fat is absent because there is no blue-black colour.

teacher.key_rationale: A lasting oily patch on paper shows fat. The starch blue-black test is a different test and is not required here. The oily patch does not show starch, and missing blue-black does not mean fat is absent.
